name: SeedLab noise compositors
plain: A library of NOISE objects that compose: seed interpolation, weighted blends with renormalise, per-channel seeds, masks, tiles, frequency split, drift, and using a latent as noise. Makes each noise a plain chainable source.
math: Interp: slerp(a,b,t) or lerp. Blend: Σ w_i/Σw · ε_i, then /std. Drift: c←slerp(c,ε_{seed+i+1},drift) per frame. PerChannel: one seed per channel, derived beyond list. Masked: ε_in·m + ε_out·(1−m). Tiled: separate seed per tile. FreqSplit: F=F_low·(r≤cutoff)+F_high·(r>cutoff), ifft real, /std. LatentNoise: resized z, tiled, /std.

props.spectrum: low from one seed, high from another (freq split)
props.normalizes_variance: yes for Blend, FreqSplit, LatentNoise (/std); no for mask and tile

label: from code
surprise: Masked and interpolated variants do not renormalize: lerp at t=0.5 shrinks variance to ½, and mask edges have the same dip.
